items.note: The prompt says exports can reach about 2 million rows, so memory use matters as well as speed.
The prompt says the signature export_orders_csv(db, path) must stay identical because three callers depend on it.
The prompt says the header line id,customer_name,total,created_at and the column order must stay identical.
The prompt says to ask before adding a dependency and that none are wanted. It also says the standard-library csv module is fine.
The prompt names the N+1 query (a per-row db.query_one customer lookup) as the known main cause.
The prompt says to avoid building the whole output in one string and to write rows to the file as you go.
The prompt says customer names can contain commas, so values must be quoted properly, and that this is the only output change.
The prompt says to run tests/test_export.py and show the command and its result.
The prompt asks for a minimal, targeted fix and says not to restructure the module or add abstractions.
